name: LM7815
full_name: LM7815 three-terminal positive 15V fixed linear voltage regulator
description: Positive fixed 15V three-terminal regulator from the 78xx family. Dropout about 2V at 1A, internally current-limited to ~1.5A with a heatsink. The metal tab is electrically GROUND, so the heatsink sits at circuit ground.

pins.name: GND
pins.description: common/ground reference; also bonded to the metal tab

typical_application: Local on-card 15V regulation downstream of a bulk filter cap; add 0.33uF in and 0.1uF out near the pins.
gotchas: 78xx pin order is IN-GND-OUT, the REVERSE of the 79xx (GND-IN-OUT); never socket-swap a 7812 with a 7912
the tab is GROUND on 78xx (safe to common-heatsink); on the 79xx complement the tab is INPUT and live
needs input (0.33uF) and output (0.1uF) bypass caps near the device for stability
1A continuous needs a heatsink; package dissipation is the real limit, not the current rating
